environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on EC2 instances in private subnets (10.0.4.0/24, 10.0.5.0/24). Service is exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with connection acceptance required (AcceptanceRequired: true). The NLB target group is internal-only with no internet gateway route in the subnet route tables. The VPC has no NAT gateway or internet gateway attached. Allowed principals are restricted to specific AWS account IDs via the endpoint service's allowed-principals list. There is no public DNS record; consumers resolve the service via the interface endpoint's private DNS (comments-api.internal.corp). The EC2 instances' security group only allows inbound TCP/443 from the NLB's ENI security group (sg-0abc123def456). No public IP is assigned to any instance. The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to authenticated IAM principals with tag 'team=platform-eng'.

config.subnet_route_tables: no igw, no nat, local + vpce routes only
